game.name: Naruto : Rise of a Ninja (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Join Konoha's most mischievous ninja apprentice in Naruto: Rise of a Ninja for Xbox 360. Roam the village in search of missions, forge your ninja and meet all the characters from Masashi Kishimoto's manga. Control your chakra to prevent the demon fox from leaving your body and become the next Hokage.
